input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only limitation of liability (p0077, buried at the end of the Section 12 indemnity) is one-way: it caps TrueLink alone (and only for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11), leaving Client's liability wholly uncapped despite the very broad Client indemnity in Sections 12(a)(i)-(iv). That is walk-away territory ("Customer's liability uncapped while Vendor's is capped") and fails the fallback, which requires a mutual 12-month fee cap with carve-outs. There is also no exclusion of indirect or consequential damages and no carve-out for confidentiality/data security or the parties' indemnities. The redline makes the cap mutual and sets the basis at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, and adds one short sentence excluding indirect and consequential damages, placing confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, and confirming Client's payment obligations are not damages. The existing carve-out for TrueLink's gross negligence and wilful misconduct is preserved.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE GREATER OF fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim AND USD 1,000,000.

ops.text: The foregoing limitation does not apply to Excluded Claims, and neither party shall be liable for any indirect or consequential damages. "Excluded Claims" means a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights. Customer's payment obligations, and all amounts due under this Agreement, are not damages for cap purposes.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the cap mutual and reset the basis to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, since as drafted only TrueLink is capped while Client's exposure under the Section 12(a) indemnity is unlimited. The added sentences exclude indirect and consequential damages, place confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement claims outside the cap, and confirm Client's payment obligations are not damages.
proposal.summary: Make the cap mutual, set it at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, and add Excluded Claims carve-outs, the indirect/consequential exclusion and the payment-obligations statement.
